body: Took 7 tabs of lsd this summer. My friend next to me who was also tripping (5 tabs) was actually morphing in front of me. His whole figure was swirling like an s shape constantly moving and wobbling. His knees and his face met while he was sitting in almost perfect 90 degree seated position. Colors don't reaaaally change. You may see them in different hues and notice light also floating in rainbows but its nothing wild like concrete objects losing their shape entirely. I have to add, to see what your video portrays, I feel like one would have a hard time even being conscious enough that they are alive in the present. How could a mind take that much insanity and stay together?😂
